profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Kyruus Health
profile.summary: Result driven Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the Software industry developing SaaS solutions empowering multiple clients and end-users. Skilled in all phases of Software development life cycle such as requirements elicitation, systems design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring and maintenance. An excellent team-player who strives to build and deliver solutions by collaborating with all stakeholders.

positions.title: Derivatives Trader
positions.description:
• Trade various financial instruments such as Stock Indices, Commodities and Currency Futures,
Options, Stocks, ETFs, REITS listed on different exchanges to profit from movement in markets /
underlying assets.
• Use screening software and technical analysis to identify trading and investment opportunities.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Served as a key member on the Software Development team charged with designing, developing, testing, and maintaining a SaaS application built using a micro-service architecture and deployed on AWS.
•	Worked primarily on developing and maintaining a Cost Estimation, Treatment Timeline and Rewards tool to help empower health insurance subscribers with Cost Transparency and Treatment information.
•	Broke down multiple monolith applications into smaller and maintainable micro-services as well as AWS Lambdas helping improve feature and bug fix delivery time to Production and achieve modularity.
•	Leveraged CI/CD pipeline to test and deploy Linux Docker containers consisting of micro-services to AWS ECS. 
•	Discovered and fixed performance bottlenecks using DataDog (stack-monitoring service), JProfiler and VisualVM (Java profilers), AWS X-Ray (distributed tracing tool) and Gatling (framework for writing load tests). 
•	Enabled 0% downtime for application updates by implementing non-sticky sessions using Redis as the session store. 
•	Made necessary changes to get products HITRUST and SOC-2 certified.
•	Created and delivered HIPAA compliant REST APIs and services to external clients.

positions.title: Part Time Front Desk Manager
positions.description:

•     Make and modify reservations

•     Contact housekeeping or maintenance staff when guests report problems
•     Compute bills, collect payments, and make change for guests
•     Review accounts and charges with guests during the check out process
